tasks.title: Memory occupancy gauge in basis points
tasks.request: Implement memory_basis_points(&Memory) -> Option<u16>. Return None if total is zero or available > total. Otherwise round used/total * 10000 to nearest integer, exact halves upward, without overflow for every u64 input. Range 0..=10000. This is a display gauge, not an event threshold or policy decision.

tasks.title: Observed direct-child RSS totals
tasks.request: Implement child_rss_by_parent(rows) as ascending parent PID -> sum of RSS in supplied child rows. Exclude self-parent rows and parent_pid=0. Count duplicate rows separately because this is a row aggregate, not PID identity resolution. Saturate u64 additions. Include a parent with zero total if a matching zero-RSS row exists. Do not infer missing processes, traverse ancestors or mutate input.

tasks.title: Occurrence-aware shared evidence
tasks.request: Implement shared_evidence(left, right). Return the multiset intersection of exact UTF-8 strings, in left occurrence order. A right occurrence can be consumed at most once. No trim, case folding, sorting, or input modification. Empty string is a normal value. Output each value min(left_count,right_count) times.

tasks.title: Nearest-rank recorded latency percentile
tasks.request: Implement latency_percentile(samples, percentile). Empty input or percentile outside 1..=100 -> None. Otherwise sort a private copy of u128 latency samples and return nearest-rank: 1-based ceil(percentile * N / 100). Retain duplicate samples; do not interpolate, narrow u128, or change original input. No overflow in rank calculation.

tasks.title: Stable event grouping with merged exact evidence
tasks.request: Implement merge_events(events) for a display-only projection. Group by (id, kind, target) exact equality, not by id alone. Groups appear at first occurrence position. For each group, retain unique exact evidence strings in first-seen order across all matching events, including removing duplicates within its first row. Preserve first row id/kind/target. Empty input empty. No policy changes or mutation of input.

tasks.title: Latest intent verification projection
tasks.request: Implement latest_verification(records, intent_id) -> Option<bool>. Match exact intent.id. Select the row with greatest observed_unix_ms, breaking equal timestamps toward the last input row. Then project selected row.verification.passed; if the selected row has no verification return None, even when older rows were verified. No match -> None. Input need not be sorted. This is display data, not authorization.

tasks.title: Observation freshness with explicit future clock state
tasks.request: Implement freshness(observed_ms, now_ms, ttl_ms) returning Future for observed > now; otherwise Fresh if age <= ttl_ms inclusive, else Stale. ttl_ms is u64 but timestamps u128; never narrow age. ttl zero means only identical timestamps are Fresh. No wall clock reads and no expiry policy changes.
